ingredients_text: GB / Lavender hand cream. Specially formulated hand cream with aloe vera, shea butter and calendula oil protects and nourishes the skin of your hands. Aloe vera and shea butter are suitable for all skin types, they restore natural shine to the skin and soothe after irritation, while calendula oil improves the appearance of dry skin. Directions: Apply the hand cream and rub gently in a circular motion, if necessary. Please note: Keep at room temperature, out of children's reach. For external use only. RS | Lavanda krema za ruke. Specijalno formulisana krema za ruke sa aloe verom, ši buterom i nevenovim uljem, štiti i neguje kožu vaših ruku.
